task_interpretation: New identified-delivery synthetic task; only emitted, delivered and queried items earn realized utility. Not a retroactive change to V2/V3.
training_objective: Oracle optimal-action-set imitation on teacher-forced demonstrations; selected by validation NLL, not heldout utility.

state_comparators.scope: Allocated numeric state excludes shared parameters, RNG object, task environment and interpreter overhead. Upper-state control is explicitly a larger cap.

selection.secondary_rule: minimum five-seed mean best_validation_nll; lexical tie break
selection.checkpoints: minimum validation optimal-set NLL including initialization

statistics.primary_estimand: mean normalized expected delivered query utility, average latent paths within seed/scenario before paired crossed seed-by-scenario bootstrap
statistics.interval: two-sided percentile 95%; pointwise; only five training seeds
statistics.paired_grouping: 64 value groups, each A0/A2/B0/B2 kept together; same pre-cue physical and RNG state within group
statistics.negative_transfer: indicator RR utility below paired baseline formed on raw replay, then averaged; includes finite-path stochastic variability
statistics.secondary_realized: four observer query draws nested under each latent path; independent synthetic outcomes, not a real future window

mechanism_controls.numerical_boundary: same frozen RR weights, scalar Lambert-W threshold replaced by independent bracketed root; no retraining
mechanism_controls.semigroup: finite CTMC matrix exponential compared to Poisson uniformization
mechanism_controls.event_baselines: LIF exact crossings; continuous-threshold ALIF event root, independently validated against DOP853; biased training surrogate disclosed

acceptance.engineering: All predeclared runtime/identity/invariant checks and all 80 training/evaluation runs complete with finite gradients
acceptance.utility_support: Primary RR-minus-ctrnn_state_cpu normalized expected utility interval lower bound > 0 on test AND shift
acceptance.mechanism_interpretation: All ablation and paired interaction intervals reported, no post-hoc winning subset; no global optimality or novelty proof
promotion_requires: dot identity and measured deployment resources

execution.training_vs_compute_cost: Common task-output/renewal ledger; actual latent spikes, CT updates, state bytes, process CPU/RSS measured separately
